senses.gloss:
लङ् लङ्, a technical term or symbol in
grammar for the terminations of the Imperfect or
First Preterite or for that tense itself.

लङ्क लङ्क, अस्, m. a proper N.; (आ), f.,
N. of the chief town in Ceylon or of the whole
island (renowned as the capital and habitation of the
great Rākṣasa Rāvaṇa and his hosts of demons,
whose conquest by Rāma-candra, q. v., after the car-
rying off of his wife Sītā by Rāvaṇa, forms the subject
of the Rāmāyaṇa; according to some accounts
Laṅkā was much larger than the island of Ceylon is
at present or even distinct from Ceylon, the first
meridian of longitude which passed through Ujjayinī
being supposed to pass through Laṅkā also); = रा-
वण-ह्रद; N. of a Śākinī or evil spirit; an
unchaste woman; a branch; a kind of grain.
—लङ्क-टङ्कटा, f., N. of a daughter of Sandhyā
(wife of Vidyut-keśa and mother of Su-keśa).
—लङ्-
का-दाहिन्, ई, m. the burner of Laṅkā, i. e. Hanu-mat
(as having set fire to the city with his burning tail).
—लङ्काधिपति (˚का-अध्˚), इस्, or लङ्का-नाथ,
अस्, or लङ्का-पति, इस्, m. lord of Laṅkā, i. e.
Rāvaṇa.
—लङ्कारि (˚का-अरि), इस्, m. the enemy
of Laṅkā, i. e. Rāma.
—लङ्कावतार (˚का-अव्˚)
N. of a Buddhist Sūtra work, (abbreviated from
सद्धर्म-ल्˚; it is one of the chief religious works
of the Buddhists, treating of their law and of many
abstruse philosophical problems.)
—लङ्का-स्थायिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, residing or being in Laṅkā; (ई), m. a
plant.
—लङ्केश or लङ्केश्वर (˚का-ईश्˚), अस्, m.
the lord of Laṅkā, i. e. Rāvaṇa.
—लङ्केश-वनारि-
केतु (˚न-अर्˚), उस्, m. ‘having the enemy of the
grove of Ravāṇa (i. e. the monkey Hanu-mat) for
an ensign, ‘N. of Arjuna.
—लङ्कोदय (˚का-उद्˚),
अस्, m. or लङ्कोदयासु, अवस्, m. pl. (in astronomy)
the equivalents of the signs in right ascension (lite-
rally ‘ascension at Laṅkā’).

लङ्कापिका or लङ्कायिका or लङ्कारिका or लङ्-
कोपिका or लङ्कोयिका, f. the plant Trigonella Cor-
niculata.
लङ्ख् लङ्ख्. See rt. लख्, p. 858, col. 3.
लङ्खनी लङ्खनी, f. the bit of a bridle.

लङ्ग् लङ्ग्, cl. 1. P. लङ्गति, &c., to go;
to go lame, limp.

1. लङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, lame, limping; (अस्), m.
limping, lameness.

लङ्ग 2. लङ्ग, अस्, m. (probably connected
with rt. लग्), union, association, connection; a lover,
paramour.
लङ्गक, अस्, m. a lover, paramour.

लङ्गल, अम्, n. = लाङ्गल, a plough; N. of a
kingdom, (also written लाङ्गल.)

लाङ्गल लाङ्गल, अम्, n. (probably con-
nected with rt. लग्; according to Uṇādi-s. I. 108.
fr. rt. लङ्ग्), a plough; a particular appearance pre-
sented by the moon; a plough-shaped beam or
timber (used in the construction of a house); the
palm tree; a kind of flower; membrum virile, (pro-
bably incorrect for लाङ्गूल); (अस्), m. a kind of
rice; N. of a son of Śuddhoda and grandson of
Śākya; (ई), f., N. of various plants, Jussiæa Repens;
Hemionitis Cordifolia; Rubia Munjista; Hedysarum
Lagopodioides; = लाङ्गलिन्, the cocoa-nut tree; N. of
a river.
—लाङ्गल-ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘plough-holder,’
a ploughman, cultivator, peasant.
—लाङ्गल-ग्र-
[]
हण, अम्, n. the act of holding or guiding the
plough, ploughing.
—लाङ्गल-चक्र, अम्, n. a par-
ticular plough-shaped diagram.
—लाङ्गल-दण्ड or
लाङ्गल-दण्डक, अस्, m. the pole or beam of a
plough.
—लाङ्गल-ध्वज, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
plough for an ensign or characteristic; (अस्), m., N.
of Bala-rāma, (see लाङ्गलिन्.)
—लाङ्गल-पद्धति,
इस्, f. a plough's path or line, furrow.
—लाङ्गल-
फाल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a ploughshare.
—लाङ्गलाख्य
(˚ल-आख्˚) or लाङ्गलाह्वय (˚ल-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
‘plough-named, called after a plough,’ (a term ap-
plied to the plant Jussiæa Repens; probably आ, f.)
—लाङ्गलापकर्षिन् (˚ल-अप्˚), ई, इणी, इ, draw-
ing the plough (said of an ox).
—लाङ्गलीषा
(˚ल-ईषा, anomalous), f. the pole of a plough.

लङ्गिम or लङ्गिमन् (?), union.
—लङ्गिम-
मय, अस्, ई, अम्, fit to be joined.
लङ्गूल, अम्, n. = लाङ्गूल, the tail of an animal.

लाङ्गुल लाङ्गुल, अम्, n. (probably fr. rt.
लग्; but see लाङ्गूल), a tail; membrum virile.

लङ्घ् लङ्घ्, cl. 1. P. A. लङ्घति, -ते,
ललङ्घ, ललङ्घे, लङ्घितुम्, to
leap, spring, go by leaps; to ascend, mount upon;
[]
to diminish, lessen, weaken, (in this sense connected
with लघु); to dry, dry up (P.); to fast, abstain
from food (A.); cl. 10. P. or Caus. लङ्घयति,
&c., to jump or spring over, leap or step over, over-
step, go beyond (with acc.); to pass over, traverse;
to ascend, mount, cross over; to transgress, trample
upon, violate, disregard, disrespect, disdain, insult,
offend, displease, injure, prevent, hinder, oppose; to
go beyond, excel, surpass, outshine, outstrip; to cause
any one to go beyond his meal-time, cause to fast
[cf. सु-लङ्घित]; to speak; to shine: Desid. of
Caus. लिलङ्घयिषति, to intend to step over; [cf.
according to some, Gr. λαγγάζω, λογγάζω, λαγχόνω,
λάχος, λόγχν, ἐλέγχω; Lat. longus, lan-
guere; Old Germ. langên, ga-lingan, ga-langon;
Goth. laggs; Angl. Sax. lang, &c.]

लङ्घक, अस्, m., Ved. one who leaps over or
transgresses, one who insults or displeases, an offender,
transgressor, violator.
लङ्घती, f., N. of a river.

लङ्घन, अम्, n. the act of leaping or jumping,
going by leaps or jumps, springing, leaping over,
overstepping, stepping across; one of a horse's paces,
curvetting, bounding; ascending, mounting, attain-
ing; the act of assaulting or storming, capturing a
fort, capture, conquest; the act of jumping over,
passing over, overstepping, exceeding, going beyond
bounds, transgressing, violation; transgressing pro-
priety; despising, disregarding, disdain, contempt;
the act of offending or displeasing, injury, harm,
offence, affront; fasting, abstinence.

लङ्घनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be lept over, to be
stepped or passed over, to be passed, passable, attain-
able; transgressible, to be violated; to be disregarded;
to be injured or wronged; to be fasted.
—लङ्घ-
नीय-ता, f. or लङ्घनीय-त्व, अम्, n. capability of
being lept or stepped over or transgressed; attain-
ability; capability of being injured.

लङ्घित, अस्, आ, अम्, lept over, overstepped,
passed beyond, passed over, traversed, transgressed,
violated, disregarded, insulted.
लङ्घितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = लङ्घनीय above.

लङ्घ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be jumped or stepped
over; to be traversed or passed, attainable; capable
of being transgressed or violated; to be neglected or
disregarded; capable of being injured or wronged;
to be made to fast.

लाङ्काकायनि लाङ्काकायनि, इस्, m. a metro-
nymic from Laṅkā.
लाङ्कायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Laṅka.

लाङ्गलक at the end of a comp. = लाङ्गल, a
plough; (अस्), m. a plough-shaped incision (in sur-
gery); (इका,-इकी), f. = लाङ्गली, Jussiæa Repens.
लाङ्गलायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Lāṅgala.

लाङ्गलि, इस्, m. (fr. लाङ्गल), a patronymic, N.
of a preceptor.

लाङ्गलिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to a
plough; (अस्), m. epithet of a particular vegetable
poison; (ई), f. Methonica Superba; [cf. लाङ्गलिकी
under लाङ्गलक.]

लाङ्गलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, furnished with or possessing
a plough; (ई), m., N. of Bala-deva (who is repre-
sented as armed with a ploughshare); N. of a pre-
ceptor; the cocoa-nut tree; a snake.
लाङ्गुलिका, f. Uraria Lagopodioides.
लाङ्गूलिका, f. Hemionitis Cordifolia.
लाङ्गुलिनी, f., N. of a river; [cf. लाङ्गूलिनी.]

लाङ्गूलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, tailed, having a tail; (ई), m.
a monkey, ape; a kind of medicinal plant; (इनी),
f., N. of a river.
